title: SEED Company Showcase Participation at Biotech Showcase 2027 for NIH SBIR/STTR Recipients
agency: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF > NATIONAL INSTITUTES OF HEALTH > NATIONAL INSTITUTES OF HEALTH OLAO
description:
Biotech/Informa Connect USA LLC shall provide presentation opportunities and event registrations for 10 NIH SEED-selected private companies participating in Biotech Showcase, January 11–13, 2027, at the Hilton San Francisco Union Square in San Francisco, California.  

 This requirement supports NIH OER SEED’s mission to advance research, product development, and commercialization through investment and strategic partnerships. Federal staff and subject matter experts evaluated Biotech Showcase and selected the event based on the alignment of its investor and partnering audience with the needs of smaller, earlier-stage companies. Participation will enable the selected companies to present their technologies, communicate their business needs, and connect with potential investors and strategic partners, supporting the advancement of NIH-funded innovations toward commercialization and potential public benefit.
